scripts.build: mkdir -p public/dist && npx terser public/app.js -o public/dist/app.js --compress --mangle && npx cleancss -o public/dist/style.css public/style.css && npx terser public/recorder.js -o public/dist/recorder.js --compress --mangle
scripts.start: npm run build && npx playwright install-deps chromium webkit 2>/dev/null; npx playwright install webkit 2>/dev/null; node server.js
